$comment: Example omp class-router config. Copy to <project>/.omp/class-router.json (project scope wins) or ~/.omp/class-router.json (global scope). Every key is optional; omitted keys keep the defaults documented in README.md.

task_complexity.instructions: How demanding is this request for an AI coding agent?

criteria.trivial: a single lookup, rename, or one-line answer; no exploration
criteria.standard: a normal multi-step edit or investigation inside one or two files
criteria.hard: large refactor, cross-cutting design, deep debugging, or long multi-file reasoning

needs_plan.instructions: Does this request need an explicit plan before any edit?

criteria.true: the change spans modules, migrations, or public interfaces
criteria.false: the change is local and reversible
